description: Optimize GSAP animations for mobile performance - reduce/disable heavy 3D transforms and parallax on smaller screens, implement viewport-based animation configuration, and ensure reduced-motion preference is respected.
steps: 1. In scripts/main.js: Add getAnimationConfig() function at the top that returns animation settings based on viewport width (disabled constellation and parallax on <=480px, reduced intensity on <=768px)
2. In scripts/main.js: Modify constellation 3D tilt initialization to skip on screens <=768px (already checks isFinePointer, add width check)
3. In scripts/main.js: Modify constellation parallax scroll animation to reduce scale/y values on mobile or disable entirely on screens <=480px
4. In scripts/main.js: Modify tile stagger animation to use shorter duration and smaller stagger values on mobile screens
5. In scripts/main.js: Modify feature-card 3D hover effect to skip on screens <=768px (already checks isFinePointer, add width check)
6. In scripts/main.js: Add resize event listener with debounce that re-evaluates animation config and refreshes ScrollTrigger
7. In scripts/services.js: Wrap any 3D transforms or heavy animations with viewport width checks - disable or simplify on mobile
8. In scripts/insights.js: Add viewport checks for any card animations - reduce y distance and stagger values on mobile
9. In scripts/aboutUS.js: Add viewport checks for statistics counter animations and reveal animations - reduce distances and durations on mobile
10. In scripts/whyUs.js and scripts/our-services.js: Add viewport checks for card/tile animations - simplify to fade-in on mobile if using 3D effects
11. In scripts/header.js: Ensure mobile menu works correctly on resize (close menu if viewport expands to desktop)

12. Verify all JS files respect prefers-reduced-motion: check that main.js already handles this, ensure other files also check window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and skip/disable animations
acceptance_criteria: Constellation 3D tilt effect disabled on viewports <=768px
Parallax scrolling effects disabled or significantly reduced on viewports <=768px
Animation durations reduced by 30-50% on mobile viewports
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query
No jank or performance issues when scrolling on mobile devices
Page still visually appealing with animations disabled/reduced
verification: Open index.html in Chrome DevTools at 375px mobile viewport and scroll - verify smooth performance
Check that constellation tiles animate in but without 3D tilt on mobile
Test with 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' emulation in Chrome DevTools (Rendering tab) - verify all animations are disabled
Test at 768px tablet width - verify reduced but not disabled animations
Check that resize from mobile to desktop re-enables animations appropriately
findings:
Successfully implemented mobile performance optimizations for GSAP animations across all JS files:

**main.js changes:**
- Added getAnimationConfig() factory function that returns animation settings based on viewport width and prefers-reduced-motion
- <=480px: Disabled constellation 3D tilt, parallax, feature-card 3D hover; reduced tile stagger duration from 1.2s to 0.6s
- <=768px: Disabled constellation 3D tilt and feature-card 3D hover; reduced parallax y from 90 to 40; reduced tile stagger duration to 0.8s
- Added resize event listener with 150ms debounce for ScrollTrigger.refresh()

**services.js changes:**
- Added isMobile, isSmallMobile, prefersReducedMotion config vars
- Disabled 3D glass tilt on service cards for <=768px
- Disabled mouse parallax on background shapes for mobile
- Reduced float-card hover scale on mobile (1.18 -> 1.08)

**insights.js changes:**
- Added viewport config vars at DOMContentLoaded start
- Disabled background shape parallax scroll for mobile
- Disabled mouse parallax for mobile
- Reduced card animation y distance (35->20) and duration (0.7->0.5) on mobile
- Skip sector icon bounce animation on small mobile

**aboutUS.js changes:**
- Added viewport config vars
- Reduced all reveal animation y distances by ~30-40% on mobile
- Reduced stagger delays from 0.1-0.12 to 0.06 on mobile
- Reduced durations from 0.65-0.8 to 0.45-0.55 on mobile

**whyUs.js changes:**
- Added viewport config vars at top level
- Wired prefersReducedMotion into existing reduceMotion check

**our-services.js changes:**
- Added viewport config vars
- Disabled checkered grid tracking effect on mobile (canvas-heavy)
- Reduced headline word y distance (40->25) and rotateX disabled on mobile
- Reduced card y distance (30->18) on mobile
- Disabled continuous loop animations (arrow bob, CTA pulse) on mobile

**header.js changes:**
- Added resize listener with debounce that closes mobile nav when viewport expands to desktop (>1100px)

All files now properly check prefers-reduced-motion media query and disable/simplify animations accordingly.
